module: Flowgraph node "Custom Trigger" (category repeat_instant, event). Creates a trigger zone (box or sphere/ellipsoid) while the project is running. Input pins: position (vec3), rotation (quat), scale (number or vec3), vehId (default: player vehicle). Outputs: enter and exit (pulses), inside, outside, vehId. The zone type (Box/Sphere) is chosen in the editor.
notes: data.highPrecision: tests 4 points of the vehicle's bounding box (instead of its position alone). data.debug: draws the zone with debugDrawer.
If the vehicle cannot be found, all outputs are set to nil.
The trigger is recomputed when position, rotation or scale change. The type is serialized (triggerType).
Code todo: to be merged with onBeamNGTrigger.

init.desc: Initializes the flags, triggerType = 'Box', data.highPrecision and data.debug to false.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets the inside/outside states and marks the trigger for recomputation.

_executionStopped.desc: Forgets the stored position, scale and points.

checkIntersections.desc: Tests whether any of the vehicle's points is inside the zone (containsOBB_point or containsEllipsoid_Point) and updates enterFlag, exitFlag, vehInside.

work.desc: Recomputes the zone if needed, gets the vehicle's points, calls checkIntersections and fills the output pins.

drawAxisBox.desc: Draws a colored box with edges via debugDrawer (debug mode).

drawCustomProperties.desc: Editor: trigger type dropdown; returns the change reason.
